name: world pilot-1 (rolling-map)
status: PILOT world for slopware/pilots/rolling-map only. Not world v0. Not used by any pre-registered experiment. E4 and world v0 are unchanged.

changes: genesis timestamp fixed (anvil --timestamp), so TIMESTAMP is a constant

nothing is ever mined (anvil --no-mining; the program is placed with anvil_setCode at a fixed address instead of a deployment transaction), so NUMBER is 0, PREVRANDAO is the genesis value (zero), and BLOCKHASH(0) is the hash of a fixed genesis
base fee and gas price fixed on the command line
every probe is a debug_traceCall against block 0 from the same caller with the same gas, as in world v0
placement rule kept: a program whose first byte is 0xEF is uninstantiable and is never evaluated (EIP-3541, as the installer refuses it)

loaderNote: not used for placement in this world; recorded for comparison with v0
fitness: F2 as E4 §5.1: probe-A instruction count of a finite run; probe A ending out of gas after more than 32 traced instructions is the loop class and has no fitness
determinismProof: scripts/pilot_world_test.ts on the 23 E4 Amendment 6 genomes across fresh anvil instances; output in determinism.txt beside this file
